entries: An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} for the duration. While in the aura, you and your allies have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Necrotic damage, and your {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximums can't be reduced. If an ally with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} starts its turn in the aura, that ally regains 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point}.
